text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"It's just a feeling, but...
Palmer, today... you seem like you're in great shape, or something."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to win.
...Or rather, I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Well, sure, nothing's ever certain!
But you know, you just get that gut feeling sometimes, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So brace yourself.
When I cross that finish line, I might just make you cry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll move them to tears! And then go wipe their tears away!
See ya!
